We also signed the White House Accord on Super Intelligence, in which companies pledged to partner with independent external auditors or evaluators. extract.lead: Policy Preparing for the 2026 US midterms Oct 14, 2026 Earlier this year, we shared an update on our election safeguards , which described how we measure and prevent political bias, detect misuse, and direct people to accurate voting information. Below, we outline how we’ve built on that work and continued to strengthen our election safeguards ahead of this year’s US midterms.
